notes.title: Version 3.0 has been released on June 12, 2025
notes.content:
1. Added image companion function, supports back-end operation, and allows for one click organization of media files in the USB drive based on configuration files.  
2. Significantly optimize the stability and performance of existing features.  
3. Considering the sales situation and development costs, the software no longer supports languages other than Chinese, English, and German. If you have any requirements, please feel free to provide feedback to me.  
﻿ 
Finally, due to significant changes in the new version's features, the testing coverage may be insufficient. Please provide timely feedback if there are any issues. Thanks for your understanding.

notes.title: Important update on May 31, 2025: Added configuration management function
notes.content:
New configuration management function has been added for photo organization. Now you can save all organization options as custom configurations for the next one click call.
You can also set a default configuration that will automatically load when the program starts.

I believe users who frequently organize images will love this feature!! For example, I often need to transfer videos taken by DJI Pocket3 to NAS, so I don't have to set them up for half a day every time in the future.

tags.feature: New configuration management function has been added for photo organization.

notes.title: Update Notes for May 21, 2025
notes.content:
I. New Options Added to Photo Organization Function

    Organize by File Type
        Files are categorized based on their extensions. Photos (including RAW format) are placed in the “Images” folder, videos in the “Videos” folder, and audio files in the “Audios” folder.
    Use Date in File Name
        If the file does not have a shooting date, the system will attempt to parse the shooting date from the file name. It supports most common date naming conventions in both Chinese and English, such as “20250101” and “2025-01-01”.
    Attempt to Obtain File Permissions
        When access is denied, the system will try to obtain the necessary permissions to operate the file, which can resolve some issues.

II. Support for New File Format

    Added support for the .mts video format used by Sony cameras.

notes.title: Updated on February 13, 2025
notes.content:
1. Now supports automatic parsing of dates in file names as shooting times. Now the software will attempt to parse the first date in the file name without Exif information. If there is, it will compare the creation time and modification time of the file and take the earliest date value as the shooting date.
2. Fixed the error where the organization was interrupted upon completion.
